verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal client, so visualizing a git commit graph across branches is a git-client capability outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Blink itself shipping git or any commit-graph view; its local command list has no git, and the VS Code connection is a third-party editor's capability, not Blink's.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can visualize the full commit graph across branches
